items.source:
Defaults to using the target class's transaction attribute if none is
associated with the target method. Any transaction attribute associated with
the target method completely overrides a class transaction attribute.
If none found on the target class, the interface that the invoked method
has been called through (in case of a JDK proxy) will be checked.
items.translation: 默认情况下，如果目标方法未关联事务属性，则使用目标类的事务属性。与目标方法关联的任何事务属性都会完全覆盖类事务属性。如果在目标类上未找到任何内容，则将检查通过调用该方法所调用的接口（在 JDK 代理的情况下）。

items.translation: 自 4.1.8 起，此方法可以被重写。
